name: ZYPPER packages
description: Installs listed system packages from the repositories the image already enables.

packages.description: Comma-separated native package entries. Whitespace around entries and empty entries are ignored.

installRecommends.description: Include optional dependencies during native package resolution.

refreshPolicy.description: Select native default refresh, check every repository, or require cached metadata without refreshing.

cleanup.description: Remove all managed caches, package files only, or skip feature cleanup. Native retention remains independent.

exactNames.description: Match entries by package name only, without falling back to a package that provides the name; applies only to this invocation.

repositories.description: Comma-separated aliases of repositories the image enables, to refresh and install from these only, or empty to use every enabled repository; applies only to this invocation.

lockTimeout.description: Seconds from 1 to 3600 that each zypper call waits for the libzypp lock, or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

connectTimeout.description: Seconds from 1 to 3600 allowed for the connection phase of each download, or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

transferTimeout.description: Seconds from 1 to 3600 without received data before a download is aborted, or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

downloadRetries.description: Retries from 0 to 10 of a failed repository metadata request, or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.
